Doctoral programme
The PhD program enables Master graduates to specialize in a research area of the Faculty of Computer Science. PhD students gain methodological expertise, insights into international research, and practical skills. The program aims to develop independence, project management abilities, and leadership skills, ideal for a career in academia or industry.
Short Facts
Programme duration: 3-4 years
Academic Degree:
Computer science: Dr.techn.
Business Informatics: Dr.rer.oec.
Study Load (ECTS): 12-18 ECTS

If you are already a doctoral candidate and have administrative questions regarding your studies, please contact the StudiesServiceCenter (SSC).
If you have questions regarding the appointment of reviewers for doctoral programmes, the blocking of the use of academic work, or require advice on matters related to study law, please contact the Office of the Studienpräses.
